description: BOPTEST, the Building Optimization Testing Framework, supports performance evaluation and benchmarking of building control strategies through a run-time environment with a RESTful HTTP API, a repository of ready-to-use building emulators, key performance indicator reporting and a results dashboard. Test cases in release v0.9.0 include BESTEST air and hydronic cases, a hydronic heat pump case, a single-zone commercial hydronic building, a two-zone apartment, a multizone residential building and simple and complex multizone offices, with more under development; each contains the dynamic Modelica model packaged as an FMU, embedded control, weather data, electricity prices, emission factors and predefined test scenarios. It came from IBPSA Project 1 Work Package 1.2 and continues in IBPSA Project 2, with funding from the U.S. DOE Building Technologies Office, VITO, KU Leuven and others; it runs locally with Docker or Podman or as a web service. Coverage: virtual buildings, not real sites. Access: open repository and web service. Licence: IBPSA licence. Caveats: emulators are models, so results depend on their fidelity. Simulation uses are benchmarking model predictive and reinforcement learning controllers for building HVAC. Related records: the Modelica IBPSA library and CityLearn.
